name: proxyscout
description: Browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Opera that downloads free proxy lists, tests them over HTTP and HTTPS and routes browser traffic through a working proxy in one click

scripts.test: node --test tests/logic.test.mjs tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/sync.test.mjs tests/firefox.test.mjs tests/opera.test.mjs tests/android.test.mjs tests/sites.test.mjs
